fusions.name: Lone Straggler
fusions.desc: Singles out an enemy up to 9 tiles away, which deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Abyssal Regard
fusions.desc: Fixes every enemy within 4 tiles in a stare from the deep that deals 28 damage, ignores resistances and leaves them [Marked] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Spyhop
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Sees Through Skin
fusions.desc: Your resonating damage cannot be resisted.
